cohort: The study included 228 blastocysts from 178 patients who underwent assisted reproductive technology during a 2-year period (2018-2019).
finding: The Diamour(r) vitrification device showed no significant differences in clinical pregnancy rate, abortion rate, live birth rate, birth weight, congenital abnormalities, or various perinatal outcomes compared to the commonly used Cryotop(r) device.
mod_finding: The devices showed no significant differences in the incidence of delivery method.
